Are you ready to begin or further develop your career in procurement within an international aviation environment? As a Junior Purchaser, you help ensure that the parts and services needed for our base and line maintenance activities are available at the right time, in the right place and at the best possible cost.

Working closely with experienced purchasers, internal stakeholders and suppliers, you will support an accurate and reliable purchasing process. You will follow up open orders, maintain procurement data and help resolve delivery issues in accordance with our internal procedures.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Creating and managing purchase orders while checking pricing, accuracy and compliance with agreed terms and internal procedures.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and following up with suppliers to support the timely delivery of parts and services.

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records, supplier information and data within our ERP and procurement systems.

• 
Identifying and escalating potential delays, discrepancies and supply risks.

• 
Acting as a day-to-day contact for suppliers regarding order status, delivery information and discrepancies.

• 
Supporting the resolution of late deliveries, shortages and other delivery-related issues.

• 
Assisting with supplier performance monitoring and collecting information for follow-up actions.

• 
Working closely with colleagues in purchasing, maintenance, logistics and other internal departments.

• 
Contributing ideas to improve order follow-up, data quality, team efficiency and service levels.

• 
Gradually building your procurement knowledge and taking ownership of purchasing activities.

You will also participate in the Aircraft on Ground, or AOG, on-call rotation approximately once every four to five weeks. During these time-critical situations, you will coordinate with suppliers, logistics providers and internal teams to help minimize aircraft downtime. This out-of-office-hours support can be provided remotely from home.

We are looking for an accurate, proactive and motivated colleague who is eager to learn and develop within an international procurement environment.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent level gained through experience.

• 
Initial experience in purchasing, supply chain, logistics or an administrative role, which is considered an advantage.

• 
Experience with an ERP system such as Navision or SAP, or a willingness to learn.

• 
Professional proficiency in English.

• 
Knowledge of French is considered an advantage.

• 
Good written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
An interest in developing your negotiation and influencing skills.

• 
Strong organizational and analytical abilities.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented and results-driven approach.

• 
Attention to detail and the ability to remain flexible under pressure.

• 
A collaborative mindset and the ability to build professional relationships.

• 
A genuine willingness to learn and grow within the role.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Assembling parts for car seats according to technical instructions

Performing visual quality checks on finished products
Identifying and reporting errors or deviations
- Vaardigheden:

/

• Sustainability & Circular Economy: De Beleyr actively promotes eco-friendly manufacturing. By extending component lifecycles through precise repairs and thermal coatings, clients achieve an average 85% reduction in  emissions and up to 75% cost savings compared to purchasing new OEM parts. All machining scraps and metal powders are 100% recycled.
• In-House Quality Control: Equipped with a dedicated measuring room, advanced measuring instruments (e.g., micrometers, precision gauges), and technical design software to validate tight tolerances for every single workpiece.
• Flexible & Custom Production: No monotone series production. The workshop processes single pieces, complex custom builds, and small repair batches ranging from intricate miniature components to massive industrial shafts.
Driven by a team of skilled machining specialists and continuous investment in automation and state-of-the-art machinery, De Beleyr Engineering guarantees high delivery reliability, short lead times, and top-tier craftsmanship.

 Required Experience:

• Practical experience with conventional cylindrical grinding is essential.
• Experience with manually setting up conventional cylindrical grinding machines independently.
• Experience with aligning and clamping workpieces correctly on the machine.
• Experience in performing measurements independently using accurate measuring tools, including micrometers.
• Experience working with high precision on a micrometer level.
• Experience reading and interpreting technical plans and mechanical drawings.
• Experience working with hard materials.
• Preferred experience with machine brands: Norton, TOS, and Danobat.
• Preferred experience or familiarity with diamond grinding wheels.
 Education & Qualifications:

• TSO level or equivalent.
• Technical education in areas such as:
• Metalworking 
• Machining 
• Mechanical Design / Shaping 
• Mechanical Engineering 
• Mechanical Techniques 
Note: Relevant practical experience is just as important as a diploma. Proven hands-on experience and technical insight carry more weight than formal qualifications.

 Competencies & Profile:

• Strong technical understanding and a good feel for machines and how workpieces react during grinding.
• Ability to work with high accuracy, control, and patience to bring workpieces step-by-step to the exact size.
• Strong focus on quality, preferring to deliver one perfect part over five parts that require subsequent rework.
• Solution-oriented mindset with the ability to identify and solve problems independently.
• Capable of working both independently with high autonomy and as part of a team.
• Driven, eager to learn, and stress resistant.
• Positive attitude, neat and safe working habits, and willing to get hands dirty.
• Professional and courteous appearance
• Willingness to be flexible regarding working hours/overtime when required.
• Language Requirements: Proficiency in English or German (Dutch is not mandatory).

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.

• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.

• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools.
